meta.title: Dengue Flavivirus Pathogenesis & Vector Control Multi-Paper Synthesis (7 Papers)
meta.authors: Katzelnick LC, Beatty PR, Biswal S, Rouvinski A, Srikiatkhachorn A, Utarini A, Peeling RW, et al.
meta.journal: Multi-Journal Synthesis (Science, Sci Transl Med, NEJM, Nature, Lancet Infect Dis)
meta.summary: Multi-disciplinary knowledge graph synthesizing 7 seminal dengue virus research studies: antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) in secondary infections, NS1-mediated endothelial hyperpermeability and vascular leak, tetravalent vaccine protection (TAK-003 / Qdenga), broadly neutralizing human monoclonal antibodies (EDIII), cytokine storm dynamics in Dengue Shock Syndrome, Wolbachia bio-interventions in Aedes aegypti, and point-of-care NS1 antigen diagnostics.

articles.title: Antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) of severe dengue disease in humans
articles.authors: Katzelnick LC, Gresh L, Halloran ME, et al.
articles.summary: Longitudinal cohort study proving pre-existing sub-neutralizing heterotypic anti-dengue IgG antibodies significantly elevate the risk of severe dengue disease and vascular leak via ADE.

articles.title: Dengue virus non-structural protein 1 (NS1) disrupts endothelial glycocalyx inducing vascular leak
articles.authors: Beatty PR, Puerta-Guardo H, Killingbeck SS, et al.
articles.summary: Discloses that secreted hexameric NS1 acts directly on endothelial cells via TLR4 to degrade sialic acid and heparan sulfate in the glycocalyx, driving plasma leakage.

articles.title: Efficacy of a tetravalent dengue vaccine in children and adolescents (TAK-003)
articles.authors: Biswal S, Reynales H, Saez-Llorens X, et al.
articles.summary: Phase 3 clinical trial of live-attenuated tetravalent dengue vaccine TAK-003 demonstrating 80.2% efficacy against virologically confirmed dengue and 90.4% against hospitalization.

articles.title: Broadly neutralizing human monoclonal antibodies target conserved epitopes on dengue E glycoprotein
articles.authors: Rouvinski A, Guardado-Calvo P, Barba-Spaeth G, et al.
articles.summary: Structural characterization of human bNAbs targeting the conserved envelope dimer epitope (EDE) spanning domains I, II, and III across all four DENV serotypes.

articles.title: Immune activation, cytokine storm, and clinical pathogenesis of severe dengue shock syndrome
articles.authors: Srikiatkhachorn A, Mathew A, Rothman AL
articles.summary: Delineates the hyperinflammatory cascade where cross-reactive memory T cells and monocytes release massive TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-8 driving acute capillary leak and shock.

articles.title: Efficacy of Wolbachia-infected mosquito deployments for the control of dengue in Yogyakarta
articles.authors: Utarini A, Indriani C, Ahmad RA, et al.
articles.summary: Cluster-randomized trial demonstrating a 77.1% reduction in dengue incidence and 86.2% reduction in hospitalizations following introgressive release of wMel Wolbachia-carrying Aedes aegypti.

articles.title: Evaluation of diagnostic tests for dengue: NS1 antigen lateral flow and multiplex RT-PCR in acute infection
articles.authors: Peeling RW, Artsob H, Pelegrino JL, et al.
articles.summary: Multi-center evaluation demonstrating >90% sensitivity for NS1 lateral flow strips in days 1-4 of fever, establishing early point-of-care diagnostic algorithms.

nodes.name: Secreted NS1 Hexamer
nodes.desc: Lipid-rich viral toxin secreted into bloodstream causing endothelial hyperpermeability.

nodes.name: Envelope (E) Glycoprotein
nodes.desc: Major viral surface protein mediating cellular receptor binding and low-pH membrane fusion.

nodes.name: E Protein Domain III (EDIII)
nodes.desc: Immunoglobulin-like domain containing principal neutralizing and serotype-specific epitopes.

nodes.name: pre-Membrane (prM) Protein
nodes.desc: Chaperone preventing premature fusion during virion assembly; target of non-neutralizing ADE antibodies.

nodes.name: DENV Serotypes (1, 2, 3, 4)
nodes.desc: Four distinct flavivirus serotypes sharing ~65-70% amino acid identity causing repeat infections.

nodes.name: Host Fc-gamma Receptor (FcgammaRIIa)
nodes.desc: Surface receptor on monocytes engaging antibody-virus complexes during ADE entry.

nodes.name: Toll-like Receptor 4 (TLR4)
nodes.desc: Innate immune receptor activated by viral NS1 triggering endothelial barrier degradation.

nodes.name: Endothelial Glycocalyx
nodes.desc: Heparan sulfate & sialic acid rich protective layer lining blood vessels destroyed in severe dengue.

nodes.name: Circulating Syndecan-1
nodes.desc: Soluble biomarker shed into serum during severe microvascular glycocalyx breakdown.

nodes.name: Antibody-Dependent Enhancement (ADE)
nodes.desc: Process where non-neutralizing antibodies promote viral entry into Fc-bearing myeloid cells.

nodes.name: Endothelial Hyperpermeability
nodes.desc: Acute loss of plasma into pleural and peritoneal cavities causing hypovolemic shock.

nodes.name: Hyperinflammatory Cytokine Cascade
nodes.desc: Massive release of TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-8, and IFN-gamma following aberrant T cell activation.

nodes.name: Monocyte Intracellular Replication
nodes.desc: Amplified viral replication within macrophages facilitated by suppressed antiviral responses.

nodes.name: Aedes Aegypti Transmission Cycle
nodes.desc: Viral propagation in salivary glands of urban day-biting Aedes mosquitoes.

nodes.name: TAK-003 Vaccine (Qdenga)
nodes.desc: Live-attenuated tetravalent vaccine based on DENV-2 backbone expressing DENV 1, 3, and 4.

nodes.name: Dengvaxia (CYD-TDV)
nodes.desc: Yellow fever 17D chimeric tetravalent vaccine restricted to baseline seropositive individuals.

nodes.name: Broadly Neutralizing EDE mAbs
nodes.desc: Human neutralizing antibodies locking E dimers preventing viral fusion across serotypes.

nodes.name: Crystalloid Fluid Resuscitation
nodes.desc: WHO standard-of-care protocol for precise fluid balance avoiding fluid overload in DSS.

nodes.name: NS1 Antigen Rapid Lateral Flow
nodes.desc: POC test detecting viral NS1 antigen within 15 minutes during early viremic phase (days 1-5).

nodes.name: Multiplex Real-Time RT-PCR
nodes.desc: Reference molecular assay detecting and serotyping DENV-1 to DENV-4 RNA genome.

nodes.name: Dengue IgM / IgG Capture ELISA
nodes.desc: Serological assay differentiating primary vs secondary infection based on antibody titers.

nodes.name: Thrombocytopenia Monitoring
nodes.desc: Hematological biomarker (<100,000/uL) tracking severity and risk of internal hemorrhage.

nodes.name: Aedes Aegypti Mosquito
nodes.desc: Primary domestic vector with anthropophilic biting behavior propagating urban outbreaks.

nodes.name: Wolbachia pipientis (wMel Strain)
nodes.desc: Intracellular endosymbiont bacterium blocking dengue virus replication inside mosquito cells.

nodes.name: CD14+ Peripheral Blood Monocytes
nodes.desc: Main target cell in secondary infection showing explosive viral output under ADE conditions.

nodes.name: Dengue Shock Syndrome (DSS)
nodes.desc: Critical phase complication characterized by narrow pulse pressure, cyanosis, and shock.
